name: directive-vs-fact
why: The split this pipeline exists for. The old shared pipeline filed 'prefers to be addressed as Sir' as a FACT, where nothing tells the assistant to do it. An instruction that is merely known is an instruction that gets ignored.
messages: From now on always address me as Sir.
And give every time in Eastern, never UTC.
Noted. Eastern from here on, Sir.
My brother Dan runs the observatory over on the ridge.
